coverage_note: Ooredoo retail network (Espaces Ooredoo, City Shops, Espaces Services) via the public API. 567 of the 572 records carry the operator's own coordinate; the other 5 are placed on their commune's point instead (geo_precision approximate, geo_method commune_centroid) because the API coordinate contradicts both the wilaya Ooredoo declares for the store and the store's own name and address. 3 further records keep their operator coordinate but a derived wilaya/commune the wilaya outlines disagree with (the nearest-centroid join filed a near-boundary point one wilaya over). operator_wilaya preserves the operator's declared wilaya on every record.
